children: Malaysia’s Pardons Board, headed by the Malaysian king, will consider jailed former Prime Minister Najib Razak’s bid for another royal intervention in his corruption conviction linked to the multibillion-dollar 1MDB scandal on Friday, according to people familiar with the matter.
Bloomberg reported the review comes as Najib seeks a further pardon after his conviction in the case.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Najib Razak’s Royal Pardon Bid to Be Reviewed Friday
